record.paper_title: On some open problems in Diophantine approximation
record.original_question: For dimension s >= 2 and positive integer q, define the discrepancy D(a_1,...,a_s;q) of the Korobov-Hlawka point sequence ((a_1 k/q), ({a_2 k/q}), ..., ({a_s k/q})) for 0 <= k <= q-1 by taking the supremum over axis-aligned boxes [0,gamma_1) x ... x [0,gamma_s) of the absolute deviation from q gamma_1...gamma_s. Is it true that min over integer vectors (a_1,...,a_s) of D(a_1,...,a_s;q) is O_s((log q)^(s-1))? Equivalently, can the extra log log q factor in Bykovskii's bound be removed?

evidence.quote: We are interested in upper bounds for the discrepancy D(a1 , ..., as ; q) = sup |#{k : ξk ∈ [0, γ1 ) × · · · × [0, γs )} − qγ1 · · · γs |.
Theorem 30. For s ⩾ 2 one has and for any positive integer q one has min D(a1 , ..., as ; q) ≪s (log q)s−1 log log q.
A famous well-known conjecture is that min D(a1 , ..., as ; q) ≪s (log q)s−1 , that is that the factor log log q in (64) may be thrown away.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix an integer $s \geq 2$. For positive integer $q$ and an integer vector $(a_1,\dots,a_s)\in\mathbb{Z}^s$, consider the Korobov–Hlawka point set in $[0,1)^s$ defined by
\[
\xi_k = \big(\{a_1 k/q\},\,\{a_2 k/q\},\,\dots,\,\{a_s k/q\}\big),\qquad k=0,1,\dots,q-1,
\]
where $\{x\}$ denotes the fractional part of $x$. Define the discrepancy
\[
D(a_1,\dots,a_s;q) \;=\; \sup_{0<\gamma_1,\dots,\gamma_s\leq 1}\bigg|\,\#\{0\le k\le q-1:\xi_k\in[0,\gamma_1)\times\cdots\times[0,\gamma_s)\}\;-\;q\,\gamma_1\cdots\gamma_s\,\bigg|.
\]
It is known that
\[
\min_{(a_1,\dots,a_s)\in\mathbb{Z}^s} D(a_1,\dots,a_s;q) \;\ll_s\; (\log q)^{s-1}\,\log\log q.
\]
Prove or disprove: for every $s\geq 2$,
\[
\min_{(a_1,\dots,a_s)\in\mathbb{Z}^s} D(a_1,\dots,a_s;q) \;\ll_s\; (\log q)^{s-1};
\]
equivalently, the factor $\log\log q$ in the above bound can be removed.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that the $\log\log q$ factor in Bykovskii's bound can be removed is described in the discrepancy/Diophantine approximation literature as a famous well-known open problem. Recent work (e.g., Shkredov on Korobov-type bounds and Zaremba's conjecture) has improved related bounds in continued-fraction settings but does not establish the desired $(\log q)^{s-1}$ discrepancy bound. No source found indicating the conjecture is resolved.

status_evidence.title: On some open problems in Diophantine approximation (arXiv:1202.4539)
status_evidence.snippet: A famous well-known conjecture is that min D(a1,...,as;q) ≪s (log q)^{s-1}, that is that the factor log log q in (64) may be thrown away.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is stated as a famous well-known open problem.

status_evidence.title: On Korobov bound concerning Zaremba's conjecture (IMRN 2026)
status_evidence.snippet: Improvement to the Korobov bound via Bourgain–Gamburd expansion machine.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress concerns related Korobov/Zaremba bounds, not the removal of log log q in Bykovskii's discrepancy bound.

status_evidence.title: On some results of Korobov and Larcher and Zaremba's conjecture (arXiv:2603.14116)
status_evidence.snippet: Improves bounds on partial quotients sums O(log q · sqrt(log log q)).
status_evidence.claim: Recent related improvements do not resolve the discrepancy conjecture.
